title: Shrink
description: This creature's Attacks deal 30% less damage for the next 3 turns.
smart_description: Shows the name of the creature that applied this power (if any). The owner's Attacks deal 30% less damage for the remaining duration. Effect decreases by 1 each turn and removes when reaching 0 (or persists if infinite).
notes: When applied, scales the owner's model to 50% size over 0.75 seconds. Reverts to normal size when removed. If the applier dies while this power is active, the power is removed. DamageDecrease is always 30%.
